Specifically, Your firm’s test method for microbial release of OTC non-sterile drug product is inadequate. You use the commercially available [redacted] system to detect total aerobic microbial count (TAMC), total yeast & mold count (TYMC), and objectionable organisms release testing for your OTC non-sterile drug products. Only 9 out of [redacted] non- sterile drug products were validated using the [redacted] system also, known as the [redacted]. Review of the [redacted] method validation revealed it to be inadequate. Additionally, you failed to establish that the [redacted] method is equivalent to the USP Compendial method. Your non- sterile drug products have the release specification of TAMC: [redacted], TYMC: [redacted]; and free of objectionable microorganism. However, the [redacted] method only provides a qualitative result of “Positive” or “Negative” for microbial growth. Also, the [redacted] method does not have the capability for speciation of objectionable organisms. A total ofbatches were released into commerce using this method. Without adequate method validation, you lack assurance that your OTC non-sterile drug products meet microbial requirements.
